background_persistence.mechanism: Tauri WindowEvent::CloseRequested intercepted to prevent_close() and hide window to system tray

autostart.mechanism: Windows Registry HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\TARS via winreg crate and Tauri command bridge

active_window_context.mechanism: Win32 API GetForegroundWindow, GetWindowTextW, GetWindowThreadProcessId, QueryFullProcessImageNameW, GetWindowRect

features: Active foreground window context bar with live refresh
Deterministic bypass command interpreter (focus, launch, terminal, browser, filesystem, obsidian)
ActionResultView rendering canonical statuses, risk levels, payload data, and errors
Global Voice PTT button and microphone volume visualizer

action_runtime_client.validation: Strict runtime validation against action-request.schema.json and action-result.schema.json
